tips.text: Buy and equip a spare Lato before the final build; the game won't consume your last secondaries, so it fails with "not enough components" if Bolto and Viper are all you own or one is equipped.
Buy and level the Lato while you gather the Neurodes and Orokin Cells, then build Bolto and Viper together.
Nobody complains about getting it; the chain is long but every step is a Market purchase.
